message:
Add Hadron Solver for Light/Dark/Exotic Hadron splits

Tries every Hadron split on copies of the save: each trial switches with
the real reset, lets the player's automation rebuild, records resources
and how long the lost Dark Matter and Singularities take to come back,
then runs Auto Lai'tela to measure destabilization progress. Trials run
in the solver worker pool, and the best split can be applied.

The Hadrons pane conversions now go through Hadrons.setSplit, and the
simulation stepper gains a uniform-tick mode, since the Black Hole
stepper can put almost all real time into a few ticks.
